visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short dark hair and a pink-and-white striped sweater stands in a brightly lit indoor room. She holds a smartphone displaying a lock screen featuring a female idol. She smiles warmly at the camera, gesturing with her free hand to introduce the topic. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up screen recording of an iPhone interface. A finger taps the lock screen, bringing up customization options. The user navigates through the 'Add New Wallpaper' menu, selecting the 'Photo Shuffle' option to demonstrate the feature's setup process. (3) The screen recording continues, showing the selection of multiple photos from an album featuring K-pop idols. The user adjusts settings for shuffle frequency and lock screen widgets. The background remains the digital interface of the phone throughout this instructional sequence. (4) The scene returns to the woman in the same indoor setting. She holds the phone and demonstrates the final result by tapping the screen to show different wallpapers appearing. She laughs and uses expressive hand movements to convey her excitement about the feature.
